activity.role: Byzantine general and commander in Italy
activity.notes: Narses returned to Italy as Justinian’s commander and completed the decisive phase of the Byzantine reconquest, defeating Totila in 552 and a Frankish-Alemannic army in 554. ATLAS records this narrow, source-backed military interval rather than his full court career.

sources.title: Narses — The Columbia Encyclopedia / Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The Columbia Encyclopedia identifies Narses as a Byzantine official and general and records his defeat of Totila in 552 and of a Frankish and Alemannic army at Capua in 554.
